claims.claim: When a second bdev reset reaches the app-thread reset handler while the controller reset function reports -EBUSY, its bdev I/O is appended to pending_resets and the handler returns.
Completing a controller reset drains pending_resets, removes each queued bdev I/O, and resumes it with success or failure derived from the controller-reset outcome.
test_pending_reset covers both successful concurrent reset completion and a controller-removal failure path for both reset I/Os.
